name: Remove Background
description: Cut the subject out of a picture: the same picture with its background made transparent (PNG). Runs on OAIY's engine (BiRefNet) or a service you add; service engine:background is the engine's.
doc:
Removes a picture's background and keeps the subject, as a PNG with a transparent background at the picture's own size.

**Service** — `OAIY engine` uses the background-removal model set up in OAIY's Engines (BiRefNet). You can also pick one of your own services (a Python rig in OAIY → Services, or a custom HTTP service): it is sent the picture as a data: URL in `{{image}}` and should answer with the new picture (base64, a data: URL or a URL) at its response path.

**In → out** — any picture (Input File, Image Gen, a URL, a data: URL) in; a PNG data URL out, which Image View and Image Save take.

inputs.name: Image
inputs.description: The picture whose background is removed

outputs.name: Image
outputs.description: The subject on a transparent background (PNG data URL)

properties.name: Service
properties.description: Which model or service removes the background. Add models in OAIY's Engines, or your own services (Python rigs) in OAIY's Services.
